name: Amazon Ancient Ruins

Two old Light Gray 6081 roof shapes remain visual-only placeholders and are explicitly excluded from the 420-part ledger until relocated to their correct assembly.
Page 22's chain, the broader page-24 crown cluster, pages 7-8 car transforms, and pages 28/30 bridge-gateway transforms remain instruction-exact.
Instruction-exact slots store explicit instructionTransform data; playable scene coordinates remain separate presentation transforms.
CAD candidates remain non-authoritative until corroborated by captured instruction pages.
